walkthroughs.body_html:
Christians read the Bible in different ways.

Literalists (often Evangelicals) read Genesis 1 as actual six 24-hour days.

Liberal Christians (often Anglicans, RCs) accept evolution and read Genesis as symbolic truth about God as creator.

The Bible itself is canonical: 66 books in Protestant Bibles, 73 in Catholic.

If God is omnipotent and omnibenevolent, why is there suffering?

Christian responses include the free will defence (Augustine) and the soul-making theodicy (John Hick).

Many Christians point to the cross — God enters human suffering — and to the hope of resurrection.

Eschatology studies the 'last things'. Christians look forward to the Parousia (Second Coming): 'This same Jesus. will come back in the same way' (Acts 1:11).

The Apostles' Creed ends: 'I believe. the resurrection of the body, and the life everlasting.'

mcqs.q: What do orthodox Christians believe about the nature of Jesus?
options: Jesus was half God and half human.
He is fully God and fully human at the same time (the incarnation) — both natures united in one person, as defined at the Council of Chalcedon.
Jesus was a human who became God after his resurrection.
Because Jesus was crucified, and the Messiah cannot die.

mcqs.q: Why do Jews not accept Jesus as the Messiah?
options: Because Jews believe Jesus never existed.
Christians believe everyone is reincarnated until they accept Jesus.
Because Jesus was crucified, and the Messiah cannot die.
Because the Jewish Messiah is expected to bring peace, rebuild the Temple and restore Israel — events the Jewish tradition holds Jesus did not accomplish.

mcqs.q: What do Christians mean by resurrection, and how does it differ from reincarnation?
options: Because Jesus was crucified, and the Messiah cannot die.

Resurrection is the once-for-all bodily raising to eternal life at the end of time (modelled on Christ's resurrection); reincarnation is the soul's repeated rebirth into new bodies. They are distinct doctrines from different religious traditions.
Resurrection and reincarnation are basically the same idea of life after death.
Christians believe everyone is reincarnated until they accept Jesus.
